Arrest of Soochow Special Policemen

The ten members of the Soochow Special Public Police
Bureau, detained in this station since 9:15 p.m. on August

(2) Wong Ching Ying (王俊英), 21, Tientsin.
(3) Woo King Pao, 19, Hangchow. 吳金寶

(5) Wong Kao Hwa (王國鏵), 26, Yangchow.

逮捕苏特局警察。

1941年8月12日晚上9点12分，隶属于特别组的洋员巡长249号菲利普斯（Philips），与西普顿（Crompton）警督及布罗德（Brodd）洋员巡长一起，通过电话向新闸巡捕房报告称，多名身穿制服的苏州特别公安局成员聚集在爱文义路42号的通为（Tung Soeng）旅馆。
警车随即被派往现场，以下列名的身穿制服的人员被带至巡捕房。他们是：
(1) 顾英（Koo Ying），25岁，宁波人。
(2) 王俊英（Wong Ching Ying），21岁，天津人。
(3) 吴金寶（Woo King Pao），19岁，杭州人。
(4) 张月鸣（Tsang Yue Ming），23岁，吴江人。
(5) 王国鏵（Wong Kao Hwa），26岁，扬州人。
(6) 彭辉义（Pang Wei Yih），20岁，上海人。
(7) 孙武昌（Sung Woo Chang），23岁，上海人。
(8) 殷光生（Ying Kwang Sung），22岁，镇江人。
(9) 殷宝生（Ying Pao S），21岁，高邮（Kompo，音译）人。
(10) 顾明平（Koo Ming Ping），23岁，杭州人。
上述人员中有两人携带刺刀。
经讯问，上述人员声称他们是苏州卫京荡村（Wei Kyung Daung Village，音译）特别公安局的成员，并且他们

Misc. 390/41. Sinsa
August 12, 41.
1 (Sheet 2)

arrived in Shanghai from Soochow, on their way to
Pootung, at 8 p.m., even date.
Arriving at the North Railway Station, Poashan
Road, they state that they made their way to Yu Ya
Ching Road by way of a No. 18 Route railless tramcar
(which they caught on North Honan Road) and entered
the Tung Soong Lodging House, 42 Avenue Road, with
a view to opening rooms there for the night owing to
the fact that they could not reach Pootung until the
morning of August 13.
Their destination in Pootung seems to be the
Shanghai Military School.
As they were members of a foreign body operating
outside the limits of the International Settlement,
efforts were made by S.I. Hsing Pei Sung, on instructions
of the Officer in Charge, to contact some responsible
authority in the Shanghai Western Area Special Police
Force with a view to their taking charge of the men
pending their departure to Pootung. He was unsuccessful, however, and up to 7 a.m. August 13 the men were
still detained in the station pending disposal.
D.O. "B" Division informed.
Copy to Special Branch.
Det. Sub-Inspector
D.D.O. "B"

于当日晚上8点从苏州抵达上海，正前往浦东。
他们称，抵达北火车站宝山路后，他们乘坐18路无轨电车（在河南北路上车）前往虞洽卿路，并进入爱文义路42号的通松（Tung Soong）旅馆，打算在那里开房过夜，因为他们要等到8月13日上午才能到达浦东。
他们在浦东的目的地似乎是上海军事学校。
由于他们是活跃在国际租界范围之外的外国机构成员，邢培松（Hsing Pei Sung，音译）警督奉主管官员指示，试图联系上海西区特别警察部队的一些负责当局，以便在他们前往浦东之前接管这些人。然而，他未能成功，直到8月13日上午7点，这些人仍被拘留在巡捕房等待处置。
已通知“B”区侦探长。
抄送特务处。

Transferring of prisoners on S.C.G.P.B. omnibus
by members of S.C.G.P.B.

At 1.50p.m. 17-12-40 a telephone message was
received from D.S.I. MacAdie, Special Branch, reporting
that about 10 prisoners in custody of two members of
Shanghai City Government Police Bureau, were being
conveyed along Peking Road to The Bund - Peking Road on
omnibus Licence No. 16123 (Route 12).

On instructions of S.I. Duncan (Charge Room duty,
Central) the undersigned accompanied by F.S. (I)
Staugaard, F.P.S. (II) 789 and C.D.C. 344, proceeded to
The Bund - Peking Road and brought to the station 11
prisoners and two S.C.G.P.B. constables, namely

P.C. 60 Sung Hai Suh (孫海蘇)
P.C. 110 Yang Ching Wo (楊建華)

who were met as they alighted from omnibus licence No.
15123.

The two S.C.G.P.B. constables explained that the
prisoners were arrested for gambling at Zik-a-wei and
were being escorted to the Floating Restaurant for
ultimate transfer to Pootung.

On instructions of P.A. D.C. Crime the two constables
were cautioned against transporting prisoners through the
Settlement without first obtaining permission of S.M.C.
and the party supplied with an escort to Floating
Restaurant.

D.O. "A" and D.D.O. "A" informed.

上海市政府警察局成员使用该局巴士转移囚犯

1940年12月17日下午1:50，接到特务处麦克阿迪（MacAdie）侦探副督察的电话报告，称约10名由两名上海市政府警察局成员看守的囚犯，正乘坐牌照号为16123的公共汽车（12路）沿北京路驶向外滩-北京路路口。

根据邓肯（Duncan）警督（中央巡捕房值班室）的指示，签署人会同洋员巡长（一级）斯托加德（Staugaard）、华籍巡长（二级）789号及华籍侦探主任344号，前往外滩-北京路路口，并将11名囚犯和两名上海市政府警察局巡捕带至巡捕房，即：

60号巡捕 孙海蘇（Sung Hai Suh）
110号巡捕 楊建華（Yang Ching Wo）

这两人是在他们从牌照号为15123的公共汽车下车时被遇到的。

两名上海市政府警察局巡捕解释说，这些囚犯因在徐家汇赌博被捕，正被护送至浮水餐厅，最终将转往浦东。

根据刑事处助理总监的指示，对两名巡捕提出警告，未经工部局许可不得在租界内运送囚犯，并为该一行人提供了护送至浮水餐厅的护卫。

已通知“A”区侦探长和“A”区副侦探长。

S.l. Special Branch
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE Sp. Br. REGISTRY 408 Station C Date December 17, 1940）

Subject City Government Policemen taking prisoners through Settlement
unescorted
Made by D.S.I. MacAdie Forwarded by D. I. Crawford

At 1.40 p.m., December 17th, 1940, D.S.I.
MacAdie boarded a Route No. 12 bus at the corner
of Hardoon and Avenue roads and found two Shanghai
City Government Police in uniform in charge of
some ten Chinese prisoners roped together.
Enquiries from the conductor of the vehicle
revealed that the Police in question had refused to
pay fares and stated that they were taking the
prisoners to Pootung. The bus was ordered to stop
at Seymour Road and Avenue Road and the assistance
of the C.P.C. on traffic duty there was sought
with a view to taking the men to the nearest Police
Station for enquiries. However, the City Government
Police refused to leave the bus and in order to
avoid incident, the vehicle was allowed to proceed.
Central Station were immediately informed by telephone
by D.S.I. MacAdie with a view to intercepting
the party on the arrival of the bus at its terminal
at Peking Rd. The Bund.

主题：市政府警察在无护卫情况下押送囚犯穿越租界
呈报人：麦克阿迪（MacAdie）侦探副督察 转呈人：克劳福德（Crawford）侦探督察

1940年12月17日下午1:40，麦克阿迪侦探副督察在哈同路与爱文义路路口登上12路公共汽车，发现两名身穿制服的上海市政府警察看管着约十名被绳索捆绑在一起的中国囚犯。
向该车售票员查询后得知，有关警察拒绝支付车费，并称他们正将囚犯送往浦东。公共汽车被命令在西摩路和爱文义路停车，并寻求在此处执行交通任务的中央巡逻队（C.P.C.）协助，旨在将这些人带到最近的巡捕房进行讯问。然而，市政府警察拒绝离开公共汽车，为避免发生事件，允许车辆继续行驶。
麦克阿迪侦探副督察立即通过电话通知中央巡捕房，以便在该公共汽车到达终点站北京路外滩时拦截该一行人。

Sir,
On instructions from Inspector Shamrock,
S.I. Ying Hun Sang and the undersigned met a party of
Nanking Students at 2.10 p.m. 4-1-40 at North Honan
and Boundary Roads, to be escorted to 76 Jessfield
Road. These students, who are actually student-police
officers of the S.C.G.P. arrived 28 strong, in
a covered, glassed-in charabanc at 1.50 p.m. together
with two instructors and two representatives of the
S.C.G.P. in a private motor car licence No.3146.
All were in uniform. On ascertaining that they were all
unarmed, S.I. Ying and the undersigned escorted them by
way of Range and Szechuen Roads to the New Asia Hotel.
Leaving there at 2.15 p.m., we travelled via Tienmong,
N. Honan, Nanking and Bubbling Well Roads, Avenue Haig
and Jessfield Road to 76 Jessfield Road, arriving at
their destination at 2.48 p.m.
No untoward incident occurred during the
the escorting of this party.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
（签名）

先生，
奉沙姆罗克警督指示，
邢汉生（Ying Hun Sang，音译）警督和签署人于1940年10月4日下午2:10在河南路与界路路口会见一群南京学生，并将他们护送至极司菲尔路76号。这些学生实际上是上海市政府警察局的学警，共28人，于下午1:50乘坐一辆有顶棚且封闭玻璃窗的大型客车抵达，另有两名教官和两名上海市政府警察局代表乘坐牌照号为3146的私人汽车同行。

Subject Arrival of 30 students from Nanking en route

Made by C.D.I. Kuh Pao Hwa Forwarded by D.I. Crawford

Commr. of Police.
Sir
I f ion
(Sn. Br.)

( Vide * report
dated 11.5.39 )
* D9196(2)

Reference the attached, the 30 students
from Nanking, who will pass through the Settlement
to the Shanghai Office of the Ministry of Police
(Nanking) at 76 Jessfield Road, on October 4, are
cadets of the Police Officers' Academy in Nanking
and have been chosen by the Ministry of Police to
be sent to Japan for further studies in Police
knowledge.

Woo Chuan Yung (吴垂莹), Special Officer
in charge of the students, was formerly Commander
of the Kiangwan Merchant Volunteer Corps. He
was kidnapped by the Japanese Military Police
from the Foo Lai Restaurant, 159 Kwangse Road,
on May 9, 1939 together with three other
Kuomintang officials, and was released in June,
1939, when he was reported to have agreed to
join the Wang Ching Wei clique.

KILE

will arrive at the North Railway Station at

4 10 40

西虹口主管官员。

一群30名身穿制服的学生
将于今天下午1:15抵达北火车站，并将经由河南路、南京路、静安寺路和海格路前往极司菲尔路76号。

他们将有一名外侨组（第一科）成员和一名华籍警督在车站路障处迎接，并将骑摩托车护送他们至目的地。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE

COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE.

Translation of Letter from the Police Bureau of the City Government of
Greater Shanghai.

October 2, 1940.

Police Department,
Shanghai Municipal Council.

Sirs,

We have to advise you that Yu Chui fun, a
special officer, is taking a party of thirty
students all dressed in uniform and sent to Japan
for further study by the Ministry of Police Affairs
through the International Settlement at 3 p.m. on
the 4th inst. on their way to Jessfield Road, and
would request you to be good enough to notify the
men under your command of their presence in the
districts concerned.

(Chop of): Police Bureau of the City
Government of Greater
Shanghai.

S.K. Ho:
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE COMMISSIONER）

大上海市政府警察局来信译文。

1940年10月2日。

上海公共租界工部局警务处，

先生们，

兹通知你们，特别警官余翠芬（Yu Chui fun，音译）正带领一群三十名均身穿制服的学生，由警察部派遣赴日本深造，将于本月4日下午3时穿过国际租界，前往极司菲尔路，恳请贵处惠予通知辖区内的下属人员知悉他们的存在。

（盖章）：大上海市政府警察局。

S.K. Ho:
（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处处长）
